AA notes that Runway's API caps prompts at 1,000 characters, so Gen-4.5 was only generated on the 61% of prompts within that limit. Board #1 is HeyGen Video 1 (1144); Kling 3.0 1080p Pro is the 1000 anchor at #15. Gen-4.5 is absent from the with-audio T2V board (30 models) because it has no native audio.

arena.ai returned 403 (Cloudflare) to every fetch, so this could not be checked at the source. Gradually.ai shows Gen-4.5 as 16th of the 22 models it tracks but records a 'source rank' of 27; the full board size is unknown. Do not score until read at arena.ai.

reviews.outlet: UD (ud.hk) Insight blog: Veo 3.1 vs Runway Gen-4.5 vs Kling 3.0
reviews.author: UD (Hong Kong digital/AI services company; no individual named)
reviews.summary: Same six prompts run through Veo 3.1, Gen-4.5 and Kling 3.0. Gen-4.5 was rated the clear winner for camera control, motion brush and character consistency across shots, second for realistic humans (good lighting, stiff arms), and behind Veo on prompt adherence. It also lacks native audio.
reviews.note: UD promotes its own AI tool directory and 'AI Battle Staff' service but sells none of these tools. Quality caveats: it repeats a stale claim that Runway is #1 on the Video Arena (not true in May 2026) and cites a third-party 'Pixflow' adherence benchmark we did not verify. No numeric score; the rating is our reading.

ratings.note: 93% one-star, 214 reviews in the last 12 months. The profile is unclaimed and has no invited reviews. Mostly billing, credit and refund complaints, then output failures (black renders, repeated errors) and bot-only support. Strong billing skew.
Under 25 reviews, so not scorable. Most reviews are 1-3 years old.

users.note: The HN threads on the Gen-4.5 launch (46107738, 46108123) had no comments about output quality. Reddit and X were skipped per instructions.

vendor_claims.text: At launch (Dec 2025), Runway said Gen-4.5 was the world's top-rated video model, citing #1 on the Artificial Analysis T2V board at 1,247 Elo as of 30 Nov 2025. That board has since been replaced by v2.1, where Gen-4.5 is 24th of 32 (silent).
Runway's app and MCP now also offer third-party models, including Kling 3.0/O3 (Sep 2026) and Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode (Oct 2026), plus Mirelo SFX 2.0 for sound (Oct 2026).

strengths: Fine camera and motion control (motion brush, keyframes)
weaknesses: Mid-to-low rank on the current AA text-to-video board
Weaker prompt adherence than Veo 3.1 in one same-prompt test
runway.notes: Default model scored: Runway Gen-4.5 (Runway's own flagship since Dec 2025; image-to-video added Jan 2026). We found no newer Runway video generation model. Aleph 2 is an editing model, and GWM Worlds 2 is a research preview. Runway now also hosts third-party models (Kling, Seedance 2.5), so a Runway user can reach top-ranked models through the same subscription. That isn't captured by scoring Gen-4.5 alone. Independent hands-on reviews of Gen-4.5 from major outlets were not found before our search budget ran out.

reviews.outlet: Analytics Vidhya: I tried the new Ray3 AI video maker
reviews.author: Sarthak Dogra
reviews.summary: Hands-on with four prompts plus image-to-video. The best clip was high quality and followed lighting details, and image animation worked well. Other clips showed objects morphing or vanishing, shaky motion and weak handling of unusual concepts. The verdict was impressive but far from ideal.
reviews.note: Covers Ray3, not the current Ray3.2. No affiliate disclosure seen; the page promotes the publisher's own courses.

luma-ai.notes: Default/flagship model: Ray3.2 (9 Jun 2026) per lumalabs.ai. A comparison blog (orcarouter.ai, a reseller, not opened) also says Ray3.2 had no AA arena entry as of 18 Sep 2026, which matches what we saw. All benchmark and review evidence we found is for Ray3 (Sep 2025) or older, so Luma's evidence is effectively stale. Luma's 'Uni' family on AA is an image model, not video.

ratings.note: A single 1-star review (Aug 2026) about a confusing UI and a card being required before any free generation. Not scorable. The listing doesn't say it is the game-art Layer, though the review content fits.
This listing is the 2022 'metadata store for production ML' product on the same domain, not today's game-art platform. Not usable.

layer-ai.notes: No independent evidence found for Layer's marketing-creative use. It uses third-party image/video models, so a benchmark would need to target whichever model a marketing workflow uses by default (not determined).

vendor_claims.text: SFX 2.0 promises synced audio for video and can change the sound while keeping the video's dialogue. The homepage shows no benchmarks or comparisons.
Mirelo SFX 2.0 became available inside Runway MCP on 15 Oct 2026 (paid plans).

mirelo.notes: We found no video-to-audio/SFX arena that includes Mirelo, and no independent review. Trustpilot and Product Hunt pages returned 404. HN has a Show HN (Aug 2025, id 44983812) and a May 2026 post (48191960) with 0-1 comments.

world-labs-marble.notes: Side tool here (camera flythrough videos for trailers). We found no evidence about its flythrough video output specifically. See docs/research/2026-10-24-level.json for Marble's world-generation reviews (design4real, QbitAI) and HN sampling.

caveats: 1) Runway Gen-4.5 and Luma Ray models are absent from all with-audio AA boards because neither has native audio. Only the silent boards include Runway, and Luma appears only on the older I2V-Silent v1.0 board with Ray 3. 2) Luma's current flagship Ray3.2 (Jun 2026) and Ray3.14 (Jan 2026) have no independent benchmark or hands-on review that we found, so Luma's evidence is stale. 3) LMArena could not be read (403). The Runway figure from gradually.ai is unverified. 4) Our WebSearch budget (shared across the session) ran out partway through. We did not complete searches for independent Gen-4.5 hands-on reviews from major outlets, YouTube same-prompt comparisons, or Layer/Mirelo coverage, so absence of evidence here is partly a search-budget gap. 5) Many 2026 'Runway vs Kling vs Veo' pages are vendor (HeyGen, PixVerse, Picsart, Megaton), reseller/API (CometAPI, orcarouter) or affiliate sites, and were not used. 6) Trustpilot scores for Runway and Luma are dominated by billing and credit complaints on unclaimed profiles. 7) Reddit and X were skipped per instructions.
